author: Hop_Salot
quote: Profoundly disappointed. Beautiful game, abysmal writing, borderline unplayable console optimization. What an absolute tragedy. Rockstar is dead.

author: Hop_Salot
quote:
It's difficult to say what happened after the first entry, but everything took a nosedive. Awful storytelling, AI voices for NPC's, objectively boring gameplay... Such a disappointment.

At least it runs well, I guess.

author: Hop_Salot
quote: I bought this game looking to recoup some of those Apple II memories from my elementary school computer lab days... and boy did it bring me back. The game isn't just a parody, but an excellent resource management game in and of itself. Awesome sense of humor, loads of replay-ability, and just a genuinely FUN game. You can't get more for less than this game. Easily the most fun I've had in a long time.
